current.text: De Larrea is a first-round rookie, picked in the 20s.
Dallas is very thin at guard. Kyrie Irving, de Larrea and Marcus Sasser are the only real guards, and almost every other player is a forward.
Josh projects him as the backup point guard.

He is worth watching on nights Kyrie Irving sits. In that case he could start and average about 10 points and 5 assists in 27 minutes. Kyrie is expected to miss games, so de Larrea could be in the rotation right away.
In Summer League he averaged about 8 to 9 assists, which is rare there. He shot under 30% and struggled to create his own shot.
At 20 he may not be ready right away. Relying on him for fantasy is not a good idea.
Dusty May is the new Dallas head coach, so the rotation is less predictable.
Dallas plays 4 games in each of our playoff weeks 19 to 21. It also has a league-high 16 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is a 6'7 point guard with good size and measurements. He dribbles and passes well and was probably the best passer at Summer League.
The experts disagree on his shooting. Some point to good shooting numbers in Europe; others worry about his shot.
He will likely have defensive problems.
